set.body:
Purpose:
Independently verify the byte decoder and the new read plan with oracles that do not reuse the production NIfTI writer or implementation assumptions.

Scope:
- Add a minimal raw NIfTI fixture builder that controls byte order, datatype, bitpix, vox_offset, slope, intercept, dimensions, and payload bytes.
- Cover every supported scalar decoder plus focused endian/scaling/error cases.
- Verify ordered block reads against analytically encoded values with explicit absolute/relative tolerances.
- Instrument or expose the pure read plan so performance behavior is asserted by window/read counts and maximum buffer size.
- Run and record the opt-in representative benchmark after correctness tests pass.

Acceptance:
- Fixtures cover uint8, int16, int32, float32, and float64.
- At least one multi-byte big-endian fixture exercises both header and payload order.
- Nontrivial slope/intercept and slope=0 semantics are verified independently.
- Truncated payload and unsupported datatype/bitpix combinations return typed failures.
- A 200 TR x 50k voxel representative selection is proven not to plan one read per element, and the recorded buffer bound is independent of total selected elements.
- Tests preserve arbitrary requested time/voxel ordering and compare floating results with explicit tolerances.
- The audit records the benchmark command and observed baseline without turning wall-clock timing into a flaky PR gate.
set.title: NIfTI conformance: byte fixtures and independent scalability guard
